title: Satellite Operator Globalstar Rallies on Report That Amazon Is in Buyout Talks
title_zh: 卫星运营商 Globalstar 因亚马逊正在进行收购谈判的报道而上涨
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Globalstar Inc. shares rose in pre-market trading after a Financial Times report that Amazon.com Inc. is in talks to acquire the satellite provider.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——英国《金融时报》报道亚马逊公司正在就收购卫星提供商进行谈判后，Globalstar Inc. 股价在盘前交易中上涨。

title: Amazon Lines Up Deal to Rival SpaceX’s Starlink: Report. Why Apple Could Be a Problem.
title_zh: 亚马逊正在与竞争对手 SpaceX 的 Starlink 达成交易：报告。为什么苹果可能会成为一个问题。
summary: Globalstar stock rose following a report Amazon is in talks to buy the satellite operator. Apple will have something to say about the deal.
summary_zh: 有报道称亚马逊正在洽谈收购这家卫星运营商，全球星股价上涨。苹果将​​就这笔交易发表评论。

title: How The Bodycote (LSE:BOY) Investment Narrative Is Shifting With New Targets And Deals
title_zh: The Bodycote (LSE:BOY) 的投资叙事如何随着新目标和交易而转变
summary: Bodycote’s updated fair value estimate has shifted slightly from £8.21 to £8.04, keeping the target close to earlier levels rather than signalling a big reset.
summary_zh: Bodycote更新后的公允价值估计从8.21英镑小幅调整至8.04英镑，使目标保持在接近之前的水平，而不是发出大幅重置的信号。

title: Poolside hunts data centre partners after CoreWeave deal falls through
title_zh: CoreWeave 交易失败后 Poolside 寻找数据中心合作伙伴
summary: AI start-up Poolside has held talks with Google and other cloud providers to revive a large Texas data centre project after a deal with CoreWeave...
